stills.screen: Home, Rimon in the hero box
stills.when: The very first time Home opens (once ever).
stills.line_en: Shalom! I'm Rimon. I'll be right here while you learn.
stills.pose: Standing, both arms flung wide open in welcome, leaning a little toward the viewer, one foot lifted. Eyes happy arcs, big open smile, cheeks extra pink.
stills.prompt:
Draw still #001 of Rimon, the pomegranate mascot of the Aleph Hebrew course. Match the reference picture (assets/img/gen/MASCOT_rimon.800.webp) exactly: same character, same colours, same flat style.
CHARACTER: Rimon is a cheerful pomegranate. Body: one round ball, very slightly wider at the bottom, flat pomegranate red #DA2933, no seeds showing, no shine, no texture. Crown: a short gold #D59E31 crown-shaped calyx sitting on top of his head, five rounded points, the middle point tallest. Leaves: two olive-green #908B2A almond-shaped leaves tucked behind the crown, one angled out to each side. Face, in the upper half of the body: two small round dark maroon #633839 dot eyes set wide apart, a small thin curved maroon smile between them and a little lower, and two soft pink #E95F67 oval cheeks just below and outside the eyes. Sash: a deep blue #0A567C band wrapped around the middle of his body, tied at the front in a small knot with two short pointed tails hanging down. Limbs: thin red stick arms ending in small rounded mitten hands with four short fingers; two short red legs with small rounded feet; arms, legs and feet are the same red as the body. He has no nose, no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothes other than the sash and the props named below.
STYLE: Flat 2D vector illustration exactly like the reference: solid flat colour fills, no outlines or strokes, no gradients, no highlights, no gloss, no texture, no grain, no 3D, no drop shadow, clean crisp edges. Expressions change only through the eyes (dots, happy upside-down arcs, closed curved lines, wide circles, a wink), small maroon eyebrow strokes only when this still asks for them, the mouth (small smile, open smile in dark maroon with a pink tongue, small round o, gentle frown) and the cheeks. Props use the same flat style and a small palette: the colours above plus cream #FAF2E0, white, warm brown #8A5A2B, soft grey #9AA3A0, sky blue #7FB8D6, dark green #1E4634 and gold.
THIS STILL: Standing, both arms flung wide open in welcome, leaning a little toward the viewer, one foot lifted. Eyes happy arcs, big open smile, cheeks extra pink.
PROPS: None.
FRAMING AND OUTPUT: Square canvas, 1024 x 1024 pixels, fully transparent background (alpha). Rimon alone, full body, facing the viewer or turned a little to one side, centred left to right. Without props he is about 80% of the canvas tall: the top of the crown about 8% below the top edge and the soles of his feet about 10% above the bottom edge, the same size and place in every still, so one still can replace another without a jump. Sitting or lying poses rest their lowest point on that same line. Props stay completely inside the canvas with a small margin; if a prop needs room, make Rimon a little smaller (never under 65% of the canvas height) and keep his feet on the same line. No scenery, no floor or ground line, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border or frame, no sparkles or glow unless this still names them.
NEVER: No text of any kind: no letters in any alphabet (no Hebrew, no English), no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature. Anything that could carry writing (a sign, card, page, screen, flag, tile, badge, map or tablet) stays blank. Do not redesign Rimon: keep the round red body, the five-point gold crown, the two olive leaves, the dot eyes, the pink cheeks, the blue knotted sash and the thin red limbs exactly as in the reference. No other characters, no people.

stills.prompt:
Draw still #066 of Rimon, the pomegranate mascot of the Aleph Hebrew course. Match the reference picture (assets/img/gen/MASCOT_rimon.800.webp) exactly: same character, same colours, same flat style.
CHARACTER: Rimon is a cheerful pomegranate. Body: one round ball, very slightly wider at the bottom, flat pomegranate red #DA2933, no seeds showing, no shine, no texture. Crown: a short gold #D59E31 crown-shaped calyx sitting on top of his head, five rounded points, the middle point tallest. Leaves: two olive-green #908B2A almond-shaped leaves tucked behind the crown, one angled out to each side. Face, in the upper half of the body: two small round dark maroon #633839 dot eyes set wide apart, a small thin curved maroon smile between them and a little lower, and two soft pink #E95F67 oval cheeks just below and outside the eyes. Sash: a deep blue #0A567C band wrapped around the middle of his body, tied at the front in a small knot with two short pointed tails hanging down. Limbs: thin red stick arms ending in small rounded mitten hands with four short fingers; two short red legs with small rounded feet; arms, legs and feet are the same red as the body. He has no nose, no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothes other than the sash and the props named below.
STYLE: Flat 2D vector illustration exactly like the reference: solid flat colour fills, no outlines or strokes, no gradients, no highlights, no gloss, no texture, no grain, no 3D, no drop shadow, clean crisp edges. Expressions change only through the eyes (dots, happy upside-down arcs, closed curved lines, wide circles, a wink), small maroon eyebrow strokes only when this still asks for them, the mouth (small smile, open smile in dark maroon with a pink tongue, small round o, gentle frown) and the cheeks. Props use the same flat style and a small palette: the colours above plus cream #FAF2E0, white, warm brown #8A5A2B, soft grey #9AA3A0, sky blue #7FB8D6, dark green #1E4634 and gold.

Sitting or lying poses rest their lowest point on that same line. Props stay completely inside the canvas with a small margin; if a prop needs room, make Rimon a little smaller (never under 65% of the canvas height) and keep his feet on the same line. No scenery, no floor or ground line, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border or frame, no sparkles or glow unless this still names them.

CHARACTER: Rimon is a cheerful pomegranate. Body: one round ball, very slightly wider at the bottom, flat pomegranate red #DA2933, no seeds showing, no shine, no texture. Crown: a short gold #D59E31 crown-shaped calyx sitting on top of his head, five rounded points, the middle point tallest. Leaves: two olive-green #908B2A almond-shaped leaves tucked behind the crown, one angled out to each side. Face, in the upper half of the body: two small round dark maroon #633839 dot eyes set wide apart, a small thin curved maroon smile between them and a little lower, and two soft pink #E95F67 oval cheeks just below and outside the eyes. Sash: a deep blue #0A567C band wrapped around the middle of his body, tied at the front in a small knot with two short pointed tails hanging down. Limbs: thin red stick arms ending in small rounded mitten hands with four short fingers; two short red legs with small rounded feet; arms, legs and feet are the same red as the body. He has no nose, no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothes other than the sash and the props named below.
STYLE: Flat 2D vector illustration exactly like the reference: solid flat colour fills, no outlines or strokes, no gradients, no highlights, no gloss, no texture, no grain, no 3D, no drop shadow, clean crisp edges. Expressions change only through the eyes (dots, happy upside-down arcs, closed curved lines, wide circles, a wink), small maroon eyebrow strokes only when this still asks for them, the mouth (small smile, open smile in dark maroon with a pink tongue, small round o, gentle frown) and the cheeks. Props use the same flat style and a small palette: the colours above plus cream #FAF2E0, white, warm brown #8A5A2B, soft grey #9AA3A0, sky blue #7FB8D6, dark green #1E4634 and gold.
THIS STILL: Holding an apple slice over a honey pot, a drop of honey falling, delighted smile.
PROPS: A red apple slice; a small gold honey pot with a wooden dipper.
Respect: Rimon never wears a prayer shawl, tefillin or a kippah, never holds a Torah scroll or a prayer book, and nothing in the picture shows the divine name or any Hebrew writing.

Sitting or lying poses rest their lowest point on that same line. Props stay completely inside the canvas with a small margin; if a prop needs room, make Rimon a little smaller (never under 65% of the canvas height) and keep his feet on the same line. No scenery, no floor or ground line, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border or frame, no sparkles or glow unless this still names them.

CHARACTER: Rimon is a cheerful pomegranate. Body: one round ball, very slightly wider at the bottom, flat pomegranate red #DA2933, no seeds showing, no shine, no texture. Crown: a short gold #D59E31 crown-shaped calyx sitting on top of his head, five rounded points, the middle point tallest. Leaves: two olive-green #908B2A almond-shaped leaves tucked behind the crown, one angled out to each side. Face, in the upper half of the body: two small round dark maroon #633839 dot eyes set wide apart, a small thin curved maroon smile between them and a little lower, and two soft pink #E95F67 oval cheeks just below and outside the eyes. Sash: a deep blue #0A567C band wrapped around the middle of his body, tied at the front in a small knot with two short pointed tails hanging down. Limbs: thin red stick arms ending in small rounded mitten hands with four short fingers; two short red legs with small rounded feet; arms, legs and feet are the same red as the body. He has no nose, no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothes other than the sash and the props named below.

Draw still #194 of Rimon, the pomegranate mascot of the Aleph Hebrew course. Match the reference picture (assets/img/gen/MASCOT_rimon.800.webp) exactly: same character, same colours, same flat style.
CHARACTER: Rimon is a cheerful pomegranate. Body: one round ball, very slightly wider at the bottom, flat pomegranate red #DA2933, no seeds showing, no shine, no texture. Crown: a short gold #D59E31 crown-shaped calyx sitting on top of his head, five rounded points, the middle point tallest. Leaves: two olive-green #908B2A almond-shaped leaves tucked behind the crown, one angled out to each side. Face, in the upper half of the body: two small round dark maroon #633839 dot eyes set wide apart, a small thin curved maroon smile between them and a little lower, and two soft pink #E95F67 oval cheeks just below and outside the eyes. Sash: a deep blue #0A567C band wrapped around the middle of his body, tied at the front in a small knot with two short pointed tails hanging down. Limbs: thin red stick arms ending in small rounded mitten hands with four short fingers; two short red legs with small rounded feet; arms, legs and feet are the same red as the body. He has no nose, no ears, no hair, no teeth and no clothes other than the sash and the props named below.
